claude_missing_hint: Claude Code is not installed or cannot be found in the login shell; without a version, Persona assumes --plugin-dir is unsupported and uses --settings for hooks
claude_too_old_hint: Hooks fall back to --settings and the persona-office skill is unavailable; upgrade Claude Code
claude_unanswered: Claude was found, but its version could not be read this time (timeout or error)
claude_unanswered_hint: This can happen when the machine is busy or the login shell starts slowly; try again later, or run zsh -ic 'claude --version' in a terminal if it persists
command_paths_bad_hint: Hooks and MCP will fail; run personad node doctor --fix with the node's current binary to rewrite them
command_paths_none_hint: Start the node once, or run personad node doctor --fix
fix_regenerate_hint: Check permissions and free disk space in {dir}
fix_reinstall_hint: You can also reinstall the resident node service (scripts/deploy/node-launchd.sh install)
fixed_launchd: Set ProcessType=Interactive in the resident node's LaunchAgent
fixed_reloaded: Reloaded the resident node's LaunchAgent (the node restarted)
flag_fix: Regenerate Persona's own files; on a Mac, set ProcessType=Interactive in the resident node's LaunchAgent and reload it (does not change your global configuration)
full_disk_access_launchd: {program} (the program run by the node's launchd service)
full_disk_access_terminal: the terminal or app running the node
generated_current: Matches what this binary would write
generated_missing_critical_hint: Sessions started by Persona cannot receive questions and approvals from your phone; restart the node or run personad node doctor --fix
generated_missing_plugin_hint: Agents started by Persona do not have the persona-office skill; restart the node or run personad node doctor --fix
generated_stale_hint: Restarting the node rewrites it; you can also run personad node doctor --fix
global_hooks_extensions: Synchronous PermissionRequest hooks: {count}, all from installed extensions ({extensions})
global_hooks_found_hint: They and Persona's phone approvals may both block permission requests and interfere with each other; Persona does not change {path}, so review it yourself when needed
global_hooks_found_with_extensions: Synchronous PermissionRequest hooks: {count} (first: {hook}), plus {extension_count} from installed extensions ({extensions})
global_hooks_invalid: The global settings.json is not valid JSON
global_hooks_invalid_hint: Claude Code cannot read it either; Persona does not change this file
herdr_no_path_hint: If HERDR_SOCKET_PATH is set, make sure it points to herdr; ignore this when this computer uses another engine
herdr_unavailable_hint: Start herdr first if it is this computer's engine; ignore this when using another engine
launchd_binary: The resident node's LaunchAgent is a binary plist and cannot be inspected
launchd_binary_hint: Run plutil -convert xml1 {path}, then check again
launchd_bootstrap_failed: launchctl bootstrap failed ({detail}): the resident node may not be running; run launchctl bootstrap {domain} {path} to load it again
launchd_fix_hint: On this Mac, run personad node doctor --fix to set ProcessType=Interactive and reload (the resident node restarts, interrupting active assistant chats)
launchd_fix_hint_inside: Run personad node doctor --fix in a terminal on this Mac (not inside a process started by the resident node, because reloading stops that node): set ProcessType=Interactive and reload (the resident node restarts, interrupting active assistant chats)
launchd_inside_fix_detail: {detail}; this fix left it unchanged because reloading inside a process started by the resident node would stop both the node and this check
launchd_invalid: The resident node's LaunchAgent is not a readable plist ({error})
launchd_invalid_hint: Reinstall the resident node service: scripts/deploy/node-launchd.sh install
launchd_missing: No resident-node LaunchAgent (the node was started over ssh or is not installed)
launchd_no_process_type: The resident-node LaunchAgent has no ProcessType: launchd applies background CPU and I/O limits to the node and its Claude processes, so Claude may not start in time
launchd_not_back_detail: {detail} (the resident node just reloaded and has not answered within {wait})
launchd_not_back_hint: Run personad node doctor again shortly; if this persists, the resident node did not start
launchd_not_back_log_hint: Run personad node doctor again shortly; if this persists, the resident node did not start. See its log at {path}
launchd_other_process_type: The resident-node LaunchAgent has ProcessType {process_type}, not Interactive: launchd limits CPU and I/O for the node and its Claude processes
launchd_stale_load: The LaunchAgent sets ProcessType=Interactive, but launchd still runs the resident node with its old loaded settings (spawn type = {spawn})
launchd_unreadable: Cannot read the resident node's LaunchAgent ({error})
node_socket_invalid_hint: This socket does not belong to a node; restart the node
node_socket_missing_hint: No node is listening: hooks and MCP silently fall back to the terminal. Make sure the hub is connected to this computer; restarting the node recreates the socket
node_socket_unanswered: The socket file exists, but no connection or response was received ({error})
positional_arguments: node doctor does not accept positional arguments
preflight_all_readable_with_dangling: Readable paths at Claude startup: {count}; dangling links Claude will skip: {dangling}
preflight_child_unsupported: {program} cannot run this check (is it an old version?)
preflight_fallback_detail: {detail}; {reason}, so only Claude Code's directory was checked, not session working directories
preflight_fallback_detail_mac: {detail}; on macOS, permissions are those of the program running doctor and may differ from the node's
preflight_fallback_no_node: No node answered this check (it is not running or the hub is not connected)
preflight_fallback_old_node: The node is too old to run this check
preflight_fallback_timeout: The node did not answer within {wait}
preflight_hung_detail: Reading {path} did not return within {wait}; {who} can remain at Loading commands and agents and never reach SessionStart
preflight_mount_hint: Check this path's permissions and whether its mount (network disk or FUSE) still responds, or move the directory elsewhere
preflight_partial_readable: Readable paths: {count}; the check did not finish
preflight_protected_folders_generic: a protected folder (Desktop, Documents, or Downloads)
preflight_read_failed_detail: Could not read {path} ({reason}); {who} may fail or hang at startup
preflight_slow_hint: Reads were too slow: check again; if this persists, check whether a working directory or link is on a network disk
preflight_symlink_loop_hint: This symlink forms a loop; remove the broken symlink or point it to a real directory
preflight_tcc_hint: macOS privacy protection blocked {target}. Either add and enable {program} in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Full Disk Access, or move it out of {folder}
preflight_unchecked_hung: Unchecked paths after an earlier read hung: {count}
preflight_unchecked_slow: Unchecked paths after the check timed out: {count}
preflight_volume_hint: {hint}. macOS also requires permission for external and network volumes: if the mount is healthy, add and enable {program} in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Full Disk Access
runtime_socket_missing_hint: No node is listening: runtimes such as DSH and pi cannot connect; ignore this if you do not use them
runtime_socket_unavailable: The socket file exists, but the connection failed ({error})
sandbox_claude_inline_settings_unreadabl: Could not read --settings file {path}; cannot determine whether Claude's own sandbox is enabled
sandbox_claude_own: Claude enables its own sandbox in {where} (sandbox.enabled), which cannot be combined with the outer sandbox
sandbox_claude_settings_invalid_json: Claude's settings {where} are not valid JSON; cannot determine whether its own sandbox is enabled
sandbox_claude_settings_invalid_sandbox: The sandbox block in Claude's settings {where} is not understood; cannot determine whether its own sandbox is enabled
sandbox_claude_settings_unreadable: Could not read Claude's settings {path}; cannot determine whether its own sandbox is enabled
sandbox_codex_config_invalid_profile: Codex's config.toml contains a profile form that is not understood; cannot determine its sandbox mode
sandbox_codex_config_unreadable: Could not read Codex's config.toml; cannot determine its sandbox mode
sandbox_codex_managed_config: Codex managed configuration {path} exists; cannot determine its sandbox mode
sandbox_codex_own: Codex's own sandbox ({mode}) conflicts with the outer sandbox; only danger-full-access can be wrapped
sandbox_codex_own_default: Codex's own sandbox (default mode) conflicts with the outer sandbox; only danger-full-access can be wrapped
sandbox_codex_profile_override: A -c argument changes the profile ({key}); cannot determine Codex's sandbox mode
sandbox_codex_project_config: The project contains {path}; cannot determine Codex's sandbox mode
sandbox_codex_remote: Codex uses another app-server (--remote); its tools do not run in this process
sandbox_codex_shared: Plain Codex may run on the shared app-server daemon, so wrapping the TUI does not contain its tools; add -c sandbox_mode="danger-full-access" to the launcher to wrap it
sandbox_unmanaged_agent: The built-in sandbox of this agent ({agent}) has not been verified, so it is not wrapped yet
sandbox_environment_hint: The {env} environment variable applies only to processes where it is set (node reads launchd's environment; personad launch reads the pane's shell)
sandbox_limits: Does not stop docker; agents in herdr or Orca started outside the managed launcher (personad launch), including direct claude or ~/.zshrc launchers and agents resumed after herdr restarts, are not sandboxed
sandbox_limits_darwin: {limits}; setuid programs such as ps, top, and sudo cannot run inside the sandbox
sandbox_limits_linux: {limits}; sandboxed agents must also restart after the node restarts (node.sock is a startup snapshot)
sandbox_on_skipped: {detail}; some starts were skipped, see the reasons below
sandbox_on_unavailable: On, but the tool is unavailable: {why}
sandbox_pane_start: Started with "{launcher}" in herdr or Orca (not the managed launcher personad launch); this version does not sandbox it, including agents resumed after a herdr restart
sandbox_runs_outside_hint: Agents still start normally, outside the sandbox
sandbox_skipped_hint: Skipped starts run normally, outside the sandbox
socket_stale_hint: An old node may have left this file behind; restart the node on this computer
title: Node self-check ({dir})
agy_hooks_installed: Persona's Antigravity CLI hooks are installed
agy_hooks_missing: Persona's Antigravity CLI hooks are not installed
agy_hooks_stale: Persona's Antigravity CLI hooks run another program than this one
agy_hooks_hint: Run personad node doctor --fix (agy panes then show their conversation under any engine)
agy_hooks_off: Persona's Antigravity CLI hooks were removed on purpose (personad node agy-hooks install puts them back)
agy_hooks_unreadable: Cannot read the Antigravity CLI hooks file ({error})
orca_stopped: Orca is installed but not running
orca_stopped_hint: Open Orca first if it is this computer's engine; ignore this when using another engine
orca_incompatible: Orca {version} is running but doesn't work with this version of Persona
orca_incompatible_hint: Update Orca and Persona to the latest version
